findings.summary: Parity 3 names ambiguous old text and mismatched patch hunks, but the fixture exercises missing old text and a valid patch only. glob/list_files/read_file are invoked without validating their returned contents. Add direct assertions when implementing these branches. This is a reading concern, not an executed surviving mutant; coverage remains pass under REV-4/REV-5.

The preview iframe is appended without first observing the original page or its document identity. The final text assertion may observe the first load or a reload, so this source scenario alone is weaker evidence for the specifically promised HMR transition. Packed behavior still needs its planned post-implementation run. No executed mutant claimed.

Key removal is checked only with settings that never supply an apiKey; trace.events/output retention and capping of consumer extension results are also not asserted directly. Exercise these declared I4 cases in the GREEN proof. No executed mutant claimed.

Parity 1 promises shell text/exit equality with the same ProjectTerminal command. Current assertions observe cat output and later build success/error, but never run the reference command for a differential text/exit comparison. Keep the explicit parity promise visible for implementation/GREEN; no executed mutant or false oracle claim was established at this checkpoint.
